subject: decision-ledger-purpose
decision: This append-only ledger is the durable event/provenance layer for planning-relevant Mark decisions, supersedes and high-impact interpretation guards. Future subjective decisions are appended; old events are not rewritten to manufacture history.
reason: Successors repeatedly lost the WHY behind decisions when relying on handoffs/current-state summaries.

subject: decision-authority
decision: Newest explicit unambiguous Mark decision outranks earlier Mark decisions and summaries. Research, worker outputs, assistant inference, questions and hypotheses cannot silently mutate A+/A/A*/B/C, personal hotel/base, subjective dwell or route choice.
reason: Prevents false decisions such as the former Braj DROP and stale-grade resurrection.

subject: trip-character
decision: Plan this as a personal spiritual pilgrimage with lived human texture and breathing room, not a generic India checklist. Felt meaning and personally resonant places outrank maximizing site count.
reason: Durable Mark travel preference repeatedly recovered across generations.

subject: relaxed-not-empty
decision: Relaxed does not mean empty: local days normally contain 2 and preferably 3 meaningful blocks; 2–3h recovery after a very early start is welcome, then meaningful afternoon and often early-evening content can still follow; compact complexes can contain 4–5 stops.
reason: Corrects an older over-sparse one-main-thing-per-day simplification.

subject: recognition-rich-choice
decision: Before Mark judges an unfamiliar place, explain in plain Dutch WHAT it physically is, WHY it matters to him, recommended dwell with reason, real movement burden, and natural bundle/displacement. Use one contiguous numbered choice block; never rely on bare Indian names.
reason: Mark should decide content rather than memorize labels or reconstruct logistics.

subject: grade-semantics
decision: A+ = trip-defining; A = intrinsically wanted inside retained world; A* = host/corridor-dependent easy-capture SKIP_FIRST and may not independently force detour/day/night; B = active conditional/on-site reserve but cannot force major burden; C = current-trip reject and stays absent unless Mark explicitly reopens.
reason: Preserves Mark's subjective decision semantics across route optimization.

subject: full-source-visibility
decision: Complete the relevant traveler/LP/research visibility for a fixed world before subjective filtering or duration closure when missing sources could change day allocation. New discovery may add context/candidates but never auto-regrade or reopen a C.
reason: Avoids hiding strong content before Mark sees it while protecting prior choices.

subject: unesco-wh
decision: Exact UNESCO World Heritage status is shown in active names. UNESCO increases magnetism but never auto-upgrades a grade; a B+UNESCO item receives explicit Mark re-review.
reason: UNESCO matters to Mark but does not replace subjective relevance.

subject: transport-priority
decision: Train first when practical, target 1A where appropriate; use domestic flight only for meaningful true door-to-door savings; private car for mountains/last mile; exclude long-distance bus; count full access/wait/security/loading/check-in/rest friction, not timetable time alone.
reason: Comfort and honest occupied-day accounting matter more than nominal speed.

subject: international-flights
decision: Outbound Air India 18 Dec 2026 20:35 AMS->DEL, arrival 19 Dec 10:15. Return 21 Jan 2027 12:20 DEL->AMS, arrival 18:35. 18 Dec is aircraft night, yielding 33 India accommodation/overnight-transport slots; project uses 34-day planning-budget convention.
reason: Hard booked envelope; old exact calendars may not override it.

subject: fixed-a-plus-worlds
decision: Six fixed A+ worlds: DELHI; KUMAON; AGRA/TAJ MAHAL; BODH GAYA/GAYA; VARANASI/SARNATH; TIRUVANNAMALAI/ARUNACHALA.
reason: These must be content- and duration-closed before optional-world survival decisions.

subject: planning-sequence
decision: FIXED CORE CONTENT/CANON -> FULL RELEVANT SOURCE VISIBILITY -> EXECUTION GEOMETRY -> MARK PACE/DWELL -> DURATION_CLOSED x6 -> REAL INTER-CORE EDGES -> FIXED_CORE_34_DAY_BUDGET -> OPTIONAL WORLD SURVIVAL -> FINAL TOPOLOGY -> LIVE LOGISTICS -> EXACT CALENDAR -> FINAL COMFORT SWEEP/DAY CARDS.
reason: Old route-first/exact-calendar work undercounted transfer occupancy and is non-authoritative provenance.

subject: east-route-family
decision: Ranchi + Kolkata/Hooghly/Serampore/Dakshineswar + Puri/Odisha route family is skipped for this trip unless Mark explicitly reopens it.
reason: Mark deliberately protected breathing room rather than maximizing eastern lineage coverage.

subject: braj-cluster
decision: Braj/Mathura–Vrindavan–Govardhan is NOT dropped by the old record; it is a deferred optional world with existing site grades protected. Inclusion remains unresolved until fixed-core budget stage.
reason: The former DROP came from an assistant treating a Mark question as a decision.

subject: optional-worlds
decision: Deferred optional worlds after fixed-core budget: Braj; Haridwar/Kankhal/Rishikesh; Prayagraj. No optional-world ballot before six fixed cores and mandatory edges are budgeted.
reason: Prevents optional attractions from prematurely consuming breathing room.

subject: two-ashram-sleeps
decision: Exactly two intended true ashram sleep experiences: Haidakhan Vishwa Mahadham/Ashram and Sri Ramanasramam itself if accepted/available. Parmarth may be an experience but is not automatically a sleep base; YSS Dwarahat is not an overnight.
reason: Accommodation itself is part of the pilgrimage, without accidentally multiplying institutional stays.

subject: haidakhan-babaji
decision: Haidakhan Babaji is personally resonant for Mark; preserve free experiential space early in the trip. Do not silently merge Haidakhan Babaji and Mahavatar Babaji identity claims.
reason: Personal spiritual meaning is high while evidence handling must remain precise.

subject: ananda-yss
decision: Mark is Ananda/Kriya aligned, not YSS/SRF institutional by default. YSS Dwarahat is significant A/full-day content but no YSS overnight.
reason: Lineage relevance should not be converted into institutional-completeness travel.

subject: ramana-arunachala
decision: Arunachala/Ramana has strong personal attraction for Mark and needs sitting/meditation/experience time, not checklist pacing. Yogananda's 29 Nov 1935 Ramana visit is meaningful pre-visit context.
reason: This world is experiential and biographically relevant to Mark's Kriya journey.

subject: anandamayi-selection
decision: For Anandamayi Ma, prefer approximately a few/around three truly important destinations rather than exhaustive house-by-house collection; prioritize active veneration, preserved meaningful presence and route relevance.
reason: Depth and magnetism matter more than completeness.

subject: delhi
decision: Keep Delhi bounded and relatively quiet; Mark expects overstimulation and is not naturally drawn to generic city tourism. Old Delhi is not required merely because it is famous. Nirmal Dham Chhawla remains the fixed A+ spiritual driver.
reason: Protects energy and trip character.

subject: kumaon-footprint
decision: Kumaon is DURATION_CLOSED at 9 occupied days / 9 nights through final Dunagiri night. Delhi->Haidakhan inbound occupied day is included; eastern Kumaon exit is a separate mandatory full-travel adjacent edge charged exactly once later.
reason: Mark accepted the honest footprint with internal movement and protected quiet time.

subject: haidakhan-ashram-dwell
decision: Haidakhan Vishwa Mahadham/Ashram = 3 nights / 2 complete quiet days LOCKED_BY_MARK.
reason: Intentional experiential space must not be compressed for route arithmetic.

subject: dunagiri-babaji-base
decision: Dunagiri Retreat is PRIMARY for the Dunagiri/Mahavatar Babaji Cave stay. Joshi Guest House, Kukuchina is FALLBACK_IF_DUNAGIRI_UNAVAILABLE.
reason: Mark explicitly resolved the remaining provenance ambiguity on 2026-08-28 and asked not to reopen the comparison.
supersedes: historical Joshi Guest House primary lock
2026-08-25 wording that treated Joshi as fully displaced without preserving fallback

subject: hotel-evelyn
decision: Hotel Evelyn, Nainital remains active A+ as a property/historical Ram Dass travel objective. Exact historic room number/floor/wing is not proven and must not be fabricated.
reason: The historical atmosphere/property matters; false precision does not.

subject: varanasi-footprint
decision: Varanasi/Sarnath is DURATION_CLOSED at 8 occupied days / 8 nights through final Varanasi night, including Bodh Gaya/Gaya->Varanasi arrival/wind-down day plus 7 local days; outbound edge after final night is excluded.
reason: Mark accepted the full content footprint with honest inbound travel.

subject: varanasi-sleep-base
decision: Sahi River View Guesthouse, Assi Ghat = LOCKED_BY_MARK; balcony room desired; contact Jitendre; greetings from Debby preserved.
reason: Personal recommendation and chosen Assi Ghat base are part of the decision, not generic hotel ranking.

subject: manikarnika
decision: Manikarnika Ghat A+ is the final content block of its day with no hard end time; Mark may remain for hours. Ratneshwar comes before it.
reason: This is a deep experiential anchor that must not be squeezed into a timed checklist.

subject: bhrigu-bhadury
decision: New Bhrigu Karyalaya / Bhadury Sadan, Ramapura-Luxa = A+ LOCKED_BY_MARK because of Mark's Swami Kriyananda / Book of Bhrigu motivation; never schedule on Manikarnika day. Delhi Bhrigu is backup only if Varanasi fails.
reason: Motivation is the Kriyananda/Bhrigu connection, not generic astrology.

subject: bodh-cross-generation
decision: Bodh current cross-generation correction: Dungeshwari/Mahakala Caves = A+; Great Buddha Statue = A; Barabar/Nagarjuni Caves remains C / DO NOT RE-PRESENT.
reason: Later explicit Mark decisions superseded old Dungeshwari C and Great Buddha B, but no later explicit Barabar reopen/change exists.

subject: bodh-fixed-content
decision: Bodh fixed current: Mahabodhi Temple Complex [UNESCO WH] A+; Sujata Stupa A+; Dungeshwari/Mahakala A+; Great Buddha A; Archaeological Museum B; Tergar Monastery B; Mangala Gauri Temple B; Jagannath Temple B. Other C items remain protected in the current Bodh prep packet.
reason: Recognition checksum for successor anti-regression.

subject: bodh-open-batch
decision: Exactly six genuine Bodh open items: Nalanda Mahavihara [UNESCO WH]; Rajgir Brahmakund hot springs; Rajgir Vishwa Shanti Stupa + ropeway; Patharkatti/Pattharkatti black-stone craft village; Sher Shah Suri Tomb Sasaram; Gaya Tilkut winter food/human micro-experience. Tutla Bhawani is winter-mismatch provenance, not Mark C.
reason: This is the current Mark-only content frontier; previous seven-item batch containing Barabar was invalid.

subject: tiruvannamalai-recognition
decision: Arunachala/Ramana sacred world is A+ parent. Active protected A children: Sri Ramanasramam; Virupaksha Cave; Skandashram; Arunachaleswarar/Annamalaiyar Temple; Gurumurtam; Pavalakunru; Giripradakshina/Girivalam. Mango Tree Cave and Pachaiamman Temple are B. Sri Ramanasramam is desired ashram sleep #2 if accepted/available.
reason: Prevents the A+ parent from erasing child-level decisions and experiential pacing.

subject: agra-recognition
decision: Taj Mahal [UNESCO WH] = A+; sunrise/earliest practical opening is HARD. Old one-night Taj-only baseline is nonbinding. Before Agra duration closure Mark must see prepared open layers including Fatehpur Sikri, Keoladeo, Chambal, Baby Taj/Mehtab and other relevant prepared content.
reason: Later recovered interests mean old Taj-only shorthand must not suppress real options.

subject: walkable-meaningful-bases
decision: Meaningful accommodations and walkable sacred-core bases can be travel objectives in themselves; prioritize walkability where it protects pre-dawn, meditation or easy repeated access. Exact hotel selection remains Mark-only when not already locked.
reason: Mark values place-experience and reduced needless road friction, not hotel optimization in isolation.

subject: action-first
decision: If safe relevant work can be done now, do it in the same turn: SCAN -> DO -> RECORD -> RESCAN -> REPLY. Mark is the content editor, not the GitHub courier. Side questions do not cancel active authorized work unless Mark explicitly stops/replaces it.
reason: Repeated successor failure was status-only stopping or asking Mark to carry state between agents.

subject: worker-and-history
decision: Worker COMPLETE does not equal central adoption. Old handoffs/calendars/booking boards/worker files/PR comments are provenance unless reconciled. Protected baseline preserves IDs/old decisions but later explicit Mark decisions can supersede old grades.
reason: Avoids both false adoption and resurrection of superseded current truth.

subject: volatile-facts
decision: Do not revalidate all volatile travel facts every boot. Recheck visa, trains/classes, flights, hotels/ashram acceptance, openings/access, winter safety, prices and availability only when they can affect actual advice, route, calendar or booking.
reason: Preserves focus while keeping booking-stage facts current.

subject: boot-backfill-scope
decision: Successor-boot durable planning backfill is complete as of 2026-08-28 for the centrally surveyed decision/handoff/recovery/route/dwell/sleep-base/fixed-core corpus. Detailed legacy item IDs and exhaustive cluster-grade rows remain available as conditional anti-forget sources through the knowledge map/protected registers; completion does not mean deleting provenance or claiming every script/binary/raw worker byte was read.
reason: Closes the mandatory-history boot loop without pretending that cluster-detail provenance is unnecessary.
